content_sections.heading: Associate Professor Eligibility
content_sections.text: Candidates must also satisfy one of the following research requirements: If the applicant has Q3 and Q4 publications, the applicant must have independently guided at least one PhD student successfully and published at least six research papers in journals indexed in Scopus, Web of Science and Scimago-listed journals; or The applicant must have published at least nine research papers in Q1 and Q2 category journals at the Assistant Professor level. The publications must be in journals indexed in Scopus, Web of Science and Scimago. Candidates must additionally fulfil one of these research requirements: Independent guidance of at least one successful PhD student and at least six Q3 or Q4 research publications in Scopus, Web of Science and Scimago-listed journals; or At least nine research papers in Q1 and Q2 category journals at the Assistant Professor level, indexed in Scopus, Web of Science and Scimago.

content_sections.heading: Professor Eligibility
content_sections.text: Candidates must also meet one of the following research requirements: Independent guidance of at least two successful PhD students and at least eight research publications in Q3 or Q4 journals indexed in Scopus, Web of Science and Scimago; or At least 12 research papers in Q1 and Q2 category journals at the Associate Professor level, indexed in Scopus, Web of Science and Scimago. Candidates must also satisfy one of these research conditions: Independent guidance of at least two successful PhD students and at least eight Q3 or Q4 research publications in Scopus, Web of Science and Scimago-listed journals; or At least 12 research papers in Q1 and Q2 category journals at the Associate Professor level, indexed in Scopus, Web of Science and Scimago.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CBIT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official CBIT website and download the prescribed application format. Fill in all personal, academic, experience and post-related information. Clearly mention the post and discipline for which you are applying. Attach academic certificates, experience certificates and other testimonials. Combine the completed application and supporting documents into a single PDF file. Email the single PDF document to [email protected] . Complete the applicable mandatory Google Form. Submit both requirements on or before 30 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: Mandatory Google Forms
content_sections.text: The application will not be considered if the candidate fails to complete the applicable Google Form.

rows.google_form: Complete Teaching and Administrative Google Form

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Prescribed CBIT application form Recent photograph, if required in the application Educational qualification certificates Semester-wise or consolidated mark sheets Experience certificates PhD certificate, where applicable Research publication details PhD guidance details for Professor and Associate Professor posts Professional or technical qualification certificates Typewriting and shorthand certificates for Stenographer posts Other certificates and testimonials supporting eligibility

content_sections.heading: General Instructions
content_sections.text: Attested photocopies of all certificates and testimonials must be attached. Candidates already employed must submit their applications through the proper channel. Incomplete applications will not be accepted. Applications received after 30 September 2026 will not be considered. No TA or DA will be paid for attending the interview. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification. The selection process will be conducted at the discretion of CBIT management. If a candidate is not found suitable for the applied post, CBIT may offer a contractual or lower post with salary based on qualification and experience. Selected candidates will be governed by CBIT rules and regulations. CBIT management reserves the right to fill or not fill any advertised post without assigning a reason.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CBIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application and complete the applicable Google Form is 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Which teaching posts are available at CBIT?
faq.answer: CBIT is accepting applications for Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor positions in CSE and allied branches, Biotechnology, ECE and English, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q3. Which non-teaching posts are included in the recruitment?
faq.answer: The non-teaching recruitment includes Doctor, HR, Accounts, Stenographer, Programmer, Administrative Executive, Alumni Coordinator, Maintenance Supervisor, Mechanical Lab staff, Student Counsellor and LCD Projector Technician positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: Candidates must send the prescribed application and supporting certificates as a single PDF to [email protected] and complete the applicable Google Form.

faq.question: Q5. Is completing the Google Form mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes. Applications will not be considered if the candidate does not complete the applicable Google Form.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor applicants will undergo a written test. Candidates who qualify will attend an interview and teaching demo on the same day.

faq.question: Q7. What salary will faculty members receive?
faq.answer: CBIT offers 7th CPC scales to faculty members under applicable AICTE or UGC norms. Salary will not be a constraint for deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Are the teaching posts regular or contractual?
faq.answer: The advertised teaching positions may be filled on a regular or contractual basis.
